title: Concat Text
cap_description: Concatenate a sequence of textable items into a single textable
documentation:
## Purpose

Stitches a sequence of textable items into one textable, with an optional separator inserted between adjacent items. The bare `media:textable` input subsumes any concrete textable variant — txt, md, rst, log, JSON-as-text — so the planner routes them all through this cap.

## Inputs

- A sequence of textable items.
- An optional `--separator` string (default: `"\n"`).

## Outputs

A single textable whose value is `items[0] + sep + items[1] + sep + … + items[N-1]`.

## Notes

- The output URN is bare `media:textable` because the merged result no longer carries any single input's format-specific tags. Pipelines that need format-specific concatenation (e.g. preserving `media:md;textable`) should produce per-format variants.
- Separator UTF-8 must be valid; non-UTF-8 bytes fail loudly.
- An empty input sequence is a hard error — silently emitting `""` would let downstream caps run on nothing without surfacing the upstream sequence being empty.

args.arg_description: Sequence of textable items to concatenate
String inserted between adjacent items (default: newline)
